title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-12 SGA repair016 status refresh with explicit compression and synchronization caveats
description:
Public SGA working-translation record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record keeps the current reader-facing PDFs, source-scan witnesses, and compact source ZIPs for SGA translation/reconstruction work.

Status at a glance. This is a substantial working-draft and repair record, not a globally certified complete edition. SGA5 French is carried through repair016; a post-repair SGA5 rescan reported no new concrete defects in tested lanes, but this is not an every-symbol certification. SGA5 English remains an unsynchronized carry-forward branch. SGA6 repair003 restores Expose VI source pp.372-387 in French from source scans, replacing compressed/noncanonical material in the projective-bundle calculation and restoring proof material, formulas, statement numbering, and remarks 1.12-1.14. A follow-up SGA6 audit still lists 234 remaining dense-region worklist rows after repair003, including 62 high-priority diagram/formula-like clues concentrated around source pp.388-460 and pp.571-680. SGA7-I should be read as working draft material with explicit compression/source-checking caveats unless a specific packet declares a source-checked range.

Filename warning. Older filenames containing words such as Complete, Strict, or Source-Checked are legacy package names and are not current global certification claims. Source-witness and aid ZIPs are locator/check layers, not textual authority by themselves.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Current public status follows the 2026-06-11/12 repair016 summary: SGA5 French has repair016 applied, SGA5 English remains unsynchronized, SGA6 repair003 fixes Expose VI pp.372-387 but leaves dense-region/diagram/English-synchronization worklists open, and SGA7-I remains working draft material. Legacy file names that say Complete or Source-Checked should be overridden by this status note.
